flora: Fan-shaped leaf (distinctive wedge leaf with a deep central split and fine, parallel line-veins)
Plum-like seed pair (rounded, smooth, pale ochre fleshy seeds hanging from a shared stem split)
Spur shoot node (chunky, wrinkled wooden knob where a cluster of leaf stems originates)
Cured leaf (a dried, brilliant golden-yellow fan leaf showing a crisp, unwrinkled silhouette)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; bold graphical silhouettes; emphasis on the clean, sweeping curves of the fan leaf margins; seeds should look plump, smooth, and slightly translucent; avoid noisy, shattered leaf textures.

visual_logic.composition: Quadrant composition: Top-Left: a pristine green fan-shaped leaf showing its prominent central notch; Top-Right: two smooth, pale ochre fleshy seeds hanging neatly together; Bottom-Left: a close-up of a wrinkled, blocky wood spur shoot; Bottom-Right: a fallen golden-yellow leaf showcasing distinct parallel venation lines.
visual_logic.ground: A smooth slab of pale ochre river siltstone, serving as a bright, highly contrasted background for the individual elements.
visual_logic.lighting: Even, bright diffused daylight, catching the waxy sheen of the seed skins and emphasizing the graphical vein lines of the foliage.
